quests.name: The Death Knights' Hearts
quests.offer: The Plague Lord's realm opens to few. Bring me the hearts of three death knights who walk Tunaria: Endraval, Bileheart and Halik. And see my assistant Xeptip first: you will need a suit.
quests.accept: I will bring you their hearts.
quests.declined: The dead are patient. I am not.

steps.journal: Speak with Necrologist Xeptip, beside Zizclank in the Dead Hills.
steps.says: A suit of zombie flesh, sewn tight. Carry it whenever you go to the Plague Lord. The dead there do not question their own.

steps.journal: Kill Deathknight Endraval among the dead trees west of Takish'Hiz and take his heart.
Kill Deathknight Bileheart in the rift of dead trees in Salisearaneen and take his heart.
Kill Deathknight Halik at the ring of rune stones south of Blackwater and take his heart.
Bring the three death knights' hearts to Necrologist Zizclank in the Dead Hills.
steps.says: Three hearts, cold as the grave. The mausoleum will open to you now.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Its first half. The guide's zombie flesh suit is crafted or bought at auction in the live game; nothing sells one here, so Xeptip hands one over. The guide lets the hearts be taken before the quest is logged; here each drops on its step, in the guide's order (Endraval, Bileheart, Halik). Deathknight Endraval is FrontiersForge's sighting (tools/quests/npcs/qe.json); Bileheart is the game's Deathknight Blieheart, his heart Corin Bileheart's.

quests.name: The Last House
quests.offer: Beyond the mausoleum's portal lies the Last House, where plague is tended like a garden. Find your way through it to its far portal, and the Plane of Disease will be open to you.
quests.declined: Then keep the hearts' cold company.
quests.started: The mausoleum is in the middle of the tomb yard.

steps.journal: Show your zombie flesh suit to the portal in the mausoleum of the Dead Hills' tomb yard.
steps.says: The portal ripples, tastes the dead flesh, and pulls you through.

steps.journal: Speak with Fatima in the Last House's entrance hall.
steps.says: A visitor? The orderlies do not like visitors. There, they have seen you.

steps.journal: Kill the Last House orderlies that turn on you.
Go to the end of the hall with the three bathtubs, as Fatima told you.

events.text: The water in the three bathtubs is black and still. Someone is tending it, and does not want to be disturbed.

steps.journal: Kill the Last House healer at the bathtubs.
Go on past Fatima and find Rebo, along the east hall.
steps.says: You should not be here. Orderlies!

steps.journal: Kill the orderlies Rebo called down on you.
Return to Fatima.
steps.says: Rebo will not help you. The pharmacist keeps the wasp venom: bring it to me.

steps.journal: Kill the Last House pharmacist and take his wasp venom.
Bring the wasp venom to Fatima.
steps.says: Good. Medelonia knows the way on. Go to her.

steps.journal: Speak with Medelonia in the middle hall.
steps.says: The physician wears the only robe the orderlies obey. Take it from him.

steps.journal: Kill the Last House physician and take his robe.
Wearing the robe, talk to the orderly at the end of the small hallway off the physician's room.
steps.says: Physician? Through the wall, then. Up the ramp and along the halls to the portal.

steps.journal: Go up the ramp and along the halls to the Last House's portal and pass through.
steps.says: The portal opens onto the Plane of Disease.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Its second half; finishing it flags the player for Zizclank's trip to PoD (unlocks). The Last House is placed in PoD's small closed building in the south-west (no walk enters it): its halls at y -12, the far side of the wall the west wing at -1.3; every spot there is ours. The orderlies stand white-faced and turn hostile by spawn events (two each time, where the guide says two or three); the bathtub popup, the healer, the pharmacist and the physician stand in their rooms; the walk through the far side is cut to the portal by the landing. The guide's rule that the trip needs the flesh suit every time is not modelled (unlocks only). The guide names no reward but the flag.

quests.name: The Whirling Portal
quests.offer: The whirling portal in the lake goes to the Queen's hive, but it opens to no stranger. Clear the lake's shore and speak to it. Then see Bonefisher Chklurgl in his tent north of the lake.
quests.accept: I will speak to the portal.
quests.declined: Then the lake keeps its secret.
quests.started: Mind the lake. Something lives in it.

steps.journal: Clear the creatures by the lake and speak to the whirling portal.
steps.says: A hum rises from the portal: the lake is sick, and something in it feeds on the puslings.

steps.journal: Speak with Bonefisher Chklurgl in his tent north of the lake.
steps.says: Something in lake eat puslings! You swim out over portal, look in mud. Kill what comes.

steps.journal: Swim out over the lake by the whirling portal and inspect the mud.

events.text: You stir the mud with your hand. It boils, and filth squids rise around you!

steps.journal: Kill the filth squids that rose from the mud.
Kill Sthlumchoxius, the kraken that kills the puslings.
Return to Bonefisher Chklurgl.
steps.says: Lake quiet again! Take chitin from Queen's hive. Show to portal: it lets you through.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Queen Qy'tha Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Steps 1-8; finishing it flags the player for the whirling portal's trip to the wasp hive (unlocks); the chitin is the guide's keepsake. The sacrifice swim (the popup's choice, deaths and rezzes), the ten minutes before Sthlumchoxius rises and the kill group's flag are simplified: the squids (four, the guide's) and Sthlumchoxius are spawned hostile beside the player at once. The 500 experience is the guide's; the faction with the puslings is ours (the guide's scepter needs a positive standing with them and names no other way to it).

quests.name: The Queen's Stinger
quests.offer: The Bonefisher gave you the chitin. The whirling portal will take you to the wasp hive now. Kill Queen Qy'tha among her children and bring her stinger to me.
quests.accept: I will bring you her stinger.
quests.started: Mind her wasps. They will see you coming.

steps.journal: Take the whirling portal to the wasp hive, kill Queen Qy'tha and take her stinger.
Bring Queen Qy'tha's stinger to Witchdoctor Muglchlur by the lake.
steps.says: The Queen's stinger! Keep it safe. The puslings will remember this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Queen Qy'tha Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Steps 9-10. The tormented caddis farmed until she spawns are left out: the Queen stands always up here. The guide's totem for the stinger needs a positive standing with the puslings (its Bertoxxulous section): that exchange is the next quest. The faction is ours, as the first part's.

quests.name: Bertoxxulous and the Throne of Plague
quests.offer: You are a friend of the puslings now. Give me the Queen's stinger and I will make a scepter of it. Show the scepter to the Throne of Bertoxxulous, past the Bloody Portal, and he will come.
quests.started: Bring your strongest. He is one tough foe.

steps.journal: Give Queen Qy'tha's stinger to Witchdoctor Muglchlur.
steps.says: There. The scepter of plague. The throne will answer it.

steps.journal: Take the Bloody Portal to the Twins' valley and show the scepter of plague to the Throne of Bertoxxulous.
steps.says: The throne shudders, and the Plaguebringer turns to face you.

events.text: Bertoxxulous the Plaguebringer rises from his throne. He has noticed you.

steps.journal: Kill Bertoxxulous the Plaguebringer.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Bertoxxulous the Plaguebringer (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The scepter is the guide's, for the stinger, with a positive standing with the puslings (factions_required). Bertoxxulous stands always up here (the guide's every-three-days throne is not modelled), so the scepter only wakes him. The guide gives no quest reward: his loot is his.

quests.name: The Fuming Portal
quests.offer: Noroxus! Ulgurglch masters want him dead. Kill the toxic slimes in the three pools round the cauldron and bring three slime hearts. Take a viturille skin too: no skin, no going through.

steps.journal: Take a viturille skin from the cillieane viturilles by the nox pools.
Kill the toxic pollutive slime in each of the three nox pools round the cauldron and take its heart.
Bring the three slime hearts to Honcho Ulgurglch.
steps.says: Three hearts! Ulgurglch mix them... there. Take to big cauldron in middle of pools.

steps.journal: Kill the plague toxicologists round the great cauldron among the three pools.
Give the fused slime heart to the fuming portal at the cauldron.
steps.says: The cauldron boils over, and the fuming portal opens.

events.text: Green smoke pours from the cauldron and the fuming portal flares open. Beyond it waits Noroxus.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Noroxus Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Steps 1-5; finishing it flags the player for the fuming portal's trip to Noroxus (unlocks). The guide's giver line names Honcho Oogurlgze, its steps Honcho Ulgurglch, the game's name. The slimes stand in the pools (the guide's connable slime that spawns them is not modelled); the skin is the guide's pass, its portal check is the flag; the goo that debuffs Noroxus, the portal's 10-15 minutes and 'Noroxus must be up' are left out.

quests.name: Blood of Noroxus
quests.offer: The fuming portal is open to you. Go through and kill Noroxus. His blood opens the closed portal, the Bloody Portal, round the ring past Ulgurglch: the way to the twins.
quests.started: Stand behind him. His breath goes only forward.

steps.journal: Take the fuming portal to Noroxus's lair, kill Noroxus and take his blood.
Show the blood of Noroxus to the Bloody Portal, round the ring past Honcho Ulgurglch.
steps.says: The closed portal drinks a drop of the blood and opens. Keep the rest: it opens every time.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Noroxus Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Step 7 and its reward: the blood of Noroxus opens the Bloody Portal to the twins (unlocks; the item is kept, as the guide's 'unlimited use').

quests.name: Yarfsnoogle's Anatomy
quests.offer: Yarfsnoogle studies the rot! Bring eight pieces: femur, organ, skin, tibia, skull, gland, eyeball and soul dust. The great ones of this plane each carry one.
quests.declined: Rot waits for no one. Yarfsnoogle waits.

steps.journal: Kill Rallius Rattican, the robed rat of the entrance valleys, and take a fetid rotting femur.
Kill the Lich Overlord behind the tree by the banker in the first tunnel and take a fetid rotting organ.
Kill Fleshripper, the vulture of the second valley, and take a fetid rotting skin.
Kill Gluboxious the Fetid in the lake past the second tunnel and take a fetid rotting tibia.
Kill Rawgl the Carnage Hound by the nox pools and take a fetid rotting skull.
Kill Noroxus in his lair and take a fetid rotting gland.
Kill Bertoxxulous the Plaguebringer and take his soul dust.
Kill Queen Qy'tha in the wasp hive and take a fetid rotting eyeball.
Bring the eight pieces to Yarfsnoogle in the nox pools' camp.
steps.says: All eight! Yarfsnoogle teaches you. But Grum is not pleased...

steps.journal: Kill Grum, who attacks as Yarfsnoogle finishes.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Spell Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Each piece is its giver's primary drop in the guide (Rotwood the Hollow's skull and the secondary drops aside), a sure drop on its step, in the guide's order but for the eyeball last; the rare spawns stand always up here. Each class's PoD ability is the spell the guide lists for it, as this server spells it (the rogue's 'Virulet Blade' is Virulent Blade Assassin, the same figures; the shaman's two spells both); the cleric's Purifying Winds of Nife has no spellpattern row, so a cleric gets Grum's robe alone. Grum's drop is the guide's item for the class as a reward on his kill: the shield (war, pal, sk) and the robe (casters, healers, monk); the helms, tunics and boots it lists for rangers, rogues and bards have no itempattern rows. Yarfsnoogle's pet's bag is left out.

quests.name: The Plague Weapons
quests.offer: The four great insects of this valley grow fat on plague. Bring me wax dust from the Moth Monarch, bile from the Locust Monarch, and the legs and mandibles of the two Matriarchs.
quests.started: Larvae first, then the great ones.

steps.journal: Kill the Moth Monarch in the pocket of seven pools and take its wax dust.
Kill the Locust Monarch and take its acidic blood bile.

items.item: front legs of the Mantis Matriarch

steps.journal: Kill the Mantis Matriarch and take her front legs.
Kill the Millipede Matriarch and take her mandibles.

items.item: front legs of the Mantis Matriarch

steps.journal: Bring the four pieces to Witchdoctor Yurplag.
steps.says: All four! Yurplag makes you a weapon worthy of this plane.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Weapon Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The larvae, mid-level spawns and despawning bosses of the guide's cycle are left out: the four bosses stand always up here, each a sure drop. The rewards are the guide's by archetype (Tank the Gory Cleaver of Mavis, Caster the Totem of Avhi, Healer the Totem of Tolawon, the game's Toluwon); The Bloodsabre (rangers, rogues, bards) and the Thorn of Deatharn (monks) have no itempattern rows, so those classes get nothing yet. The guide's 'some small xp' has no figure.

quests.name: Plagueswine Tusks
quests.offer: The plague swine in these valleys grow fine tusks. Bring me four and I will pay you well, as often as you like.

steps.journal: Take four plagueswine tusks from the plague swine of the second valley.
Bring four plagueswine tusks to Tuskmaster Helgley in the tents by the first pond.
steps.says: Fine tusks. Here is your pay. Bring more any time.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Spell Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Its note on Tuskmaster Helgley's hunt and gather: 250,000 experience (the guide's 'about 250k') and 956 tunar for four tusks, no faction with the puslings (the guide's own words). The drop chance is ours.

quests.name: Scuzz Toad Eyes
quests.offer: Scuzz toads in the lakes past the second tunnel have good eyes for stew. Bring Pluxklez four, and Pluxklez gives stew. Again and again!

steps.journal: Take four scuzz toad eyes from the scuzz toads in Gluboxious's lake.
Bring four scuzz toad eyes to Pluxklez, where the Lich Overlord spawns.
steps.says: Good eyes! Here, stew. Eat it, feel better.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Spell Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Its note on Pluxklez: 251,000 experience and scuzz toad stew for four eyes (the guide's figures). The scuzz toads' spawn cycle from the jellies and piranhas is left out: they stand at the lake (tools/quests/npcs/qe.json); the stew takes the sondereel fish soup's effect, not the guide's 156 a tick; the drop chance is ours.
